strings.这一页回答一个问题：「这类算法到底能解哪几类问题」。先给结论：它们解的是「解空间: This page answers one question: “what kinds of problems can these algorithms actually solve?” The short answer: black-box search problems whose solution space is too large for exact algorithms. The familiar “discrete / continuous / mixed” split is only one dimension — the type of variable — and a full classification has six more orthogonal dimensions.
strings.三分钟入门：什么是元启发式？: A three-minute intro: what is a metaheuristic?
strings.站名里的「群智能」取其广义（群体智慧隐喻的优化算法总称，是本站的主流家风）——实: “Swarm intelligence” in the site name is meant in the broad sense (the umbrella for optimisation algorithms based on collective-intelligence metaphors, the site's dominant style); what is actually covered spans the whole metaheuristic spectrum: evolutionary computation, physics-inspired, human/social metaphors, hybrid recipes and multi-objective methods — not just ants and bees.
strings.一句话：元启发式 = 给「精确算法算不动的大搜索问题」用的通用试错框架——不保证: In one sentence: a metaheuristic is a general trial-and-error framework for large search problems that exact algorithms cannot handle — it does not guarantee optimality, but gives a good enough solution in limited time.
strings.类比：在陌生城市找最短路线，精确算法要把每种走法都试完（n 个城市有 (n−1): Analogy: finding the shortest route in an unfamiliar city, an exact algorithm has to try every possible way (n cities have (n−1)!/2 tours — already more than 10³⁰ for 30 cities); a metaheuristic “probes in promising directions based on experience and occasionally detours on purpose to escape a local trap” and approaches a good answer within a few hundred steps.
strings.名字拆开：heuristic = 经验法则（不保证对、但通常好用）；meta-: The name, taken apart: heuristic = rule of thumb (not guaranteed correct, but usually useful); meta- = one level up — not tied to a specific problem; for a new problem you only swap two building blocks, the “encoding + neighbourhood”, and the main loop stays the same.
strings.什么时候用：问题规模大到精确算法超时、且「足够好」可接受时。30 个城市可以穷举: When to use one: when the problem is too large for exact algorithms to finish in time and “good enough” is acceptable. 30 cities can be enumerated; 3000 cities go to a metaheuristic.
strings.下一步：往下看「四连问」定位你的问题类型 → 顶部「算法 ▾」挑一个家族 → 在: Next: read the “four questions” below to place your problem → pick a family under “Algorithms ▾” at the top → run the TSP demo on any algorithm page.
strings.拿到任何一个优化问题，依次回答四个问题，就能定位它的类别、该读哪支文献、配哪套编: For any optimisation problem, answer four questions in turn to locate its class, the relevant literature and the right encoding:
strings.① 变量是什么类型？: ① What type are the variables?
strings.函数基准、超参调优、神经网络权重: Function benchmarks, hyper-parameter tuning, neural-network weights
strings.VRP 带时间窗、流水车间调度: VRP with time windows, flow-shop scheduling
strings.⏳ 混合编码尚未支持；VRP / 车间调度有教学简化版: ⏳ Mixed encodings are not supported yet; VRP / job-shop scheduling have simplified teaching versions
strings.② 有几个优化目标？: ② How many objectives are there?
strings.③ 解的评价稳定吗？: ③ Is the evaluation of a solution stable?
strings.昂贵黑箱（示意模型；代理模型辅助尚未实现）: Expensive black box (illustrative model; surrogate assistance is not implemented yet)
strings.变量类型之外，每个问题还要逐条回答这些维度。同一算法配上不同的「编码 + 邻域: Besides the variable type, every problem should be answered on each of these dimensions. The same algorithm combined with a different “encoding + neighbourhood + constraint handling” can be reused across dimensions.
strings.多目标用 Pareto 支配关系 + 拥挤度，或标量化（加权/切比雪夫）: Multi-objective uses Pareto dominance + crowding distance, or scalarisation (weighted / Tchebycheff)
strings.NSGA-II（引用数万级）、MOPSO、MOEA/D: NSGA-II (tens of thousands of citations), MOPSO, MOEA/D
strings.罚函数、修复算子、Deb 可行性规则: Penalty functions, repair operators, Deb's feasibility rules
strings.本站背包页用: Used by the knapsack page here
strings.（装不下按性价比扔）: (drop items with the lowest value for weight when they do not fit)
strings.多样性保持、记忆库、预测迁移: Diversity maintenance, memory, prediction and transfer
strings.本站连续页的 SA/HC 都带重启组件: SA/HC on the continuous page here include a restart component
strings.本站 ACO 的候选列表就是性能关键: The candidate list in ACO here is the performance key
strings.有界/无界/多维/二次/子集和/折扣…: Bounded / unbounded / multidimensional / quadratic / subset sum / discounted…
strings.列表/预着色/边/全着色/最大独立集: List / precoloring / edge / total colouring / maximum independent set
strings.最近开设设施指派: Assign to the nearest open facility
strings.词条域（VRP、调度、选址、图问题、黑箱…）: Entry domain (VRP, scheduling, location, graph problems, black box…)
strings.{n} 个 TSP 算法按站内 {n} 个家族分组——每个家族下一行是它的定位；: The {n} TSP algorithms are grouped into {n} families on the site — one line under each family gives its positioning; the full family tree is in the algorithm library overview. Most algorithms are natively continuous, and the site has discretised them onto permutations / binary vectors.
strings.算法（点击看 TSP 演示页）: Algorithms (click for the TSP demo page)
strings.NSGA-II（Deb et al. 2002，非支配排序 + 拥挤度）: NSGA-II (Deb et al. 2002, non-dominated sorting + crowding distance)
strings.不依赖问题梯度/结构信息的高层搜索框架。名字里的 meta 意为「更高层」——它: A high-level search framework that does not rely on gradient or structural information of the problem. “Meta” means “one level up”: it directs how a lower-level heuristic (such as 2-opt) is used. Characteristics: randomness, giving up the optimality guarantee, and only the encoding needs to change for a new problem.
strings.探索=看没去过的地方，开发=在好解附近深挖。所有元启发式的调参本质都是平衡这对矛: Exploration = looking at places not yet visited; exploitation = digging deeper near good solutions. Tuning any metaheuristic is essentially balancing this pair: the inertia weight of PSO, the temperature of SA and the mutation rate of GA are different knobs with the same role.
strings.把每个解的高度设为目标函数值得到的地形。单峰只有一个谷，多峰遍地局部最优。Ras: The terrain obtained by setting the height of every solution to its objective value. A unimodal landscape has a single valley, a multimodal one has local optima everywhere. The Rastrigin function is the standard multimodal test — on the continuous page here you can see algorithms getting stuck in valley bottoms.
strings.解 A 支配 B = A 在所有目标上不比 B 差且至少一个更好。不被任何解支配: Solution A dominates B = A is no worse than B on every objective and better on at least one. The solutions not dominated by any other form the front. The output of multi-objective optimisation is not one solution but a whole front, from which the decision maker chooses afterwards.
strings.把种群按支配关系分层（front 1/2/3…），层内用拥挤度（同一层里邻居稀疏: The population is layered by dominance (front 1/2/3…), and within a layer crowding distance (how sparse the neighbours are) preserves diversity. It has tens of thousands of citations and is the default starting point of multi-objective evolution.
strings.元启发式 + 局部搜索的混合体（道金斯 meme 的双关）。本站 TSP 侧所有: A hybrid of a metaheuristic and local search (a pun on Dawkins' meme). The “periodic 2-opt” of every population algorithm on the TSP side here is the memetic component — the automatic “is it really optimising?” test checks specifically that “the descent is not all due to local search”.
strings.把问题的解表示成算法能操作的结构。同一算法换编码就能换问题：PSO 在连续域是实: Representing a solution of the problem as a structure the algorithm can operate on. The same algorithm changes problem when the encoding changes: PSO is a real vector plus velocity in the continuous domain, becomes a permutation plus swap sequence for TSP and a 0/1 vector for knapsack. The encoding layer is the main workload of metaheuristic engineering.
strings.把违反约束的解修正为可行解。背包页的实现：超重时按「单位重量价值最低先扔」。比罚: Turns a solution that violates constraints into a feasible one. On the knapsack page: when overweight, drop the item with the lowest value per unit weight first. It is cleaner than a penalty function — the search always stays inside the feasible region.
strings.公认的测试函数集：Sphere（单峰）、Rastrigin（强多峰）、Rosen: Widely accepted test functions: Sphere (unimodal), Rastrigin (strongly multimodal), Rosenbrock (banana valley), Ackley (nearly flat globally with a rough edge). Comparison experiments in papers are mostly run on these functions.
strings.目前没有已知多项式时间精确算法的问题类。TSP、背包、车间调度都是。元启发式的用: A class of problems with no known polynomial-time exact algorithm. TSP, knapsack and job-shop scheduling are all NP-hard. The metaheuristic's niche: the solution does not need to be “optimal”, only “good enough and affordable”.
strings.「是否真在优化」自动测试: The “is it really optimising?” automatic test
strings.本站的硬门槛：算法必须①显著优于随机基线 ②第 1 代到最后一带有真实迭代进步。: A hard requirement of this site: an algorithm must ① clearly beat the random baseline and ② show real iterative progress from the first generation to the last. Without it you can end up with a fake algorithm whose passing grade comes entirely from initial seeding while the iterations spin idle — DE and GWO here both fell into this, and the lessons are written on their algorithm pages.
strings.低维、多峰、评价便宜时，均匀采样本身就是强基线（2D Rastrigin 上 6: In low dimensions with multimodal landscapes and cheap evaluations, uniform sampling is itself a strong baseline (the best of 6000 random samples on 2D Rastrigin is about 0.6). Any algorithm paper must report a comparison with it — the algorithm list of every domain here keeps a random baseline.
strings.收敛曲线明明在下降，但下降并不是算法本身的功劳——比如全靠初始解质量高、或全靠附: The convergence curve clearly goes down, but the algorithm itself gets no credit for it — for example everything comes from a good initial solution or from an accompanying local search. How to tell: switch the local search off and run again, or compare the best value at generation 1 and generation 200; if it hardly changes it is a fake run.
strings.把「排列」编码成一串实数，解码时按数值大小排序得到排列。它让只会处理实数的算法（: Encodes a “permutation” as a string of real numbers and decodes by sorting the values. It lets algorithms that only handle real numbers (PSO, CMA-ES and so on) solve permutation problems such as TSP or graph colouring; the price is a distorted search space whose effect has to be verified case by case — every combination here has passed the “is it really optimising?” check.
strings.一个局部最优点周围「往下走最终会掉进它」的那片区域。不同算法从不同起点出发却得到: The region around a local optimum from which “walking downhill eventually falls into it”. When different algorithms starting from different points arrive at the same solution, they have often fallen into the same basin of attraction.
strings.先在 TSP 页看懂「种群 + 收敛曲线 + 基线」三件套，理解灰线/红线的区别: First understand the “population + convergence curve + baseline” trio on the TSP page and the difference between the grey and red lines.
strings.去 连续函数页看算法的「原生形态」——PSO/DE/GWO 在这里是教科书公式原: Go to the continuous-function page to see the algorithms in their “native form” — PSO/DE/GWO use the textbook formulas unchanged — then return to the TSP page to see what discretisation changed.
strings.去 背包页理解「编码 + 约束修复」：同一批算法换到 0/1 向量上长什么样。: Go to the knapsack page to understand “encoding + constraint repair”: what the same algorithms look like on 0/1 vectors.
strings.去 多目标页理解 Pareto 前沿：为什么输出从「一个解」变成「一群解」。: Go to the multi-objective page to understand the Pareto front: why the output changes from “one solution” into “a set of solutions”.
strings.每个算法页底部的踩坑记录值得通读——离散化的坑比算法本身更深。: The pitfall notes at the bottom of every algorithm page are worth reading in full — the pitfalls of discretisation run deeper than the algorithms themselves.
